## Purpose
Continue completed HE37 with source-coordinate finite-mass H1 electron-impact ionization gain. Retain workflow1.0.0 / approval0.2 and the original Jacobi coordinates of Le–Cambier.

## Scope
Common-temperature/common-bulk Maxwell reference plus independent infinitesimal electron and neutral-H STF perturbations; explicit uniform angular density in the original Jacobi directions. Reuse unchanged LC radial source and HE36/REI contracts. Derive species number, heat and STF sources with exact event momentum/energy, and compress energy-sharing to existing moments.

## Progress
R1 accepted and backed up; 1/20 stages. Parent publication b97bccaabc246af5672b2ead8dfa9f08d169da6d. New branch contract commit 485e753038f600540a6a5586c41dfb9f1cf8d46b.

## Limits
Empirical angular calibration, unequal temperatures/drifts, finite Grad amplitude, species allocation of total gas stress, thermal/UV evolution, metric feedback, CI/DR/CX for other species, and a fully reactive19-channel nuclear network remain separate dependencies. Old completed IVP/diagnostic/benchmark/render workloads are reused without replay.

Each accepted stage receives an actual cumulative archive ACK and Git commit. Final results, validation, pins and two handoffs will be recorded on completion.
